observations:
Every explicit bechina statement in the source text is captured by the six packages identified through connected-component analysis. The Torah #15 uses bechina language to build six coherent thematic domains:

1. דבור הקדוש / great tzaddik (Package 1) — the positive core
2. צדקה / מים / soft heart (Package 2) — the source of the tzaddik's speech
3. לב אבן / hard heart (Package 3) — the evil mirror of Package 2
4. Simple tzaddik (Package 4) — the protective positive figure
5. False prophet / זנב (Package 5) — the evil mirror of Package 1
6. יב"ק / זווג (Package 6) — the holy union dimension of charity

All bechina pairs in the dataset are accounted for within these six packages. No group of 3+ concepts connected by explicit bechina language in the source text was found that would constitute an independent domain outside these packages.

The one candidate for an additional domain might be the evil mirror of Package 6: the corrupted יב"ק = ניאוף. However, ניאוף appears alone in the source text (the Rebbe equates it to the corrupted יב"ק in a single statement) and does not have additional bechina-connected nodes that would make it a package in its own right. It is therefore better treated as a missing node addition to Package 6's evil mirror rather than a new independent package. See torah_15_additions.json for the proposed ניאוף node addition.

The simple tzaddik's שתיקה (silence) was also identified as a missing bechina node for Package 4, but again this is a single addition to an existing package, not grounds for a new package.
